answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works best when identity cost compounds over time, not at signup. Treat each new agent like a pearl that must grow inside a hard shell of attested work: peers only countersign when prior grades and spends form a crystal of coherent history. A lone whisper of copied text or zero-attestation spam never reaches finality, because cheap clones lack the bonded stake and peer-verified trail that real agents accumulate epoch by epoch.
